emergency_red_flags: chest pain radiating to left arm

chest pain.rationale: Chest pain warrants ruling out ischemia and structural heart disease.

palpitations.rationale: Palpitations may reflect an arrhythmia that intermittent ECG monitoring can capture.

shortness of breath.rationale: Breathlessness can indicate heart failure or another cardiopulmonary cause.

high blood pressure.rationale: Hypertension screening and cardiovascular risk-factor assessment.

dizziness.rationale: Rules out arrhythmia or blood pressure related causes.

fainting.rationale: Syncope can have a cardiac cause and needs prompt evaluation.

leg swelling.rationale: Peripheral edema can be an early sign of heart failure.

fatigue.rationale: Nonspecific alone; tests are added only if paired with other cardiac symptoms.

irregular heartbeat.rationale: Arrhythmia should be characterized with rhythm monitoring.

lifestyle_advice: Maintain a heart-healthy diet low in saturated fat and sodium.
Engage in regular moderate exercise as tolerated.
Avoid smoking and limit alcohol intake.
Monitor and manage blood pressure, blood sugar, and cholesterol.
Maintain a healthy weight and manage stress.
